Alton Brown is the Bill Nye of food
Got a link for a good recipe?

1 large egg yolk
1/4 tsp Dijon mustard
3/4 cups vegetable/canola oil (I like using olive oil)
1 tsp white wine vinegar
1+1/2 tsp freshly squeezed lemon juice
1/4 tsp Salt

Makes: 1 1/4 cups

  1. Whisk eggs 15 sec, add everything but oil, whisk until yolk thickens, ~30 sec.
  2. Slowly add oil while whisking. Whisk for 30 sec extra after all oil is added. Serve.
Does it keep well at all? Or make just enough to be consumed?
It keeps for a couple days refrigerated in an airtight container.

1 large egg

1 cup extra light tasting olive oil

1 tbsp lemon juice

1/4 tsp salt

Put everything in a wide-mouth mason jar, stick an immersion blender in, all the way to the bottom and turn it on then slowly pull the blender up (make sure you don't splatter everywhere) then in and out of the jar a few times until it's fully mixed.
